quests.title: Race on the Cam
quests.summary: An Oxford punter has challenged the whole Cam to a race.

steps.text: Borrow a punt pole from the porter at Queens' College.
Race Rupert on the Backs, over the Mathematical Bridge.
Tell the Punt Captain at Quayside.

quests.reward: Punt Pole Tip (charm), Chelsea Buns and England standing.

quests.title: Newton's Apple
quests.summary: An apple has fallen from Newton's tree, and a story needs setting straight.

steps.text: Show the apple to the librarian in Trinity's Wren Library.
Set the doubting student by the Corpus Clock straight.
Back to the College Gardener by the apple tree.

quests.reward: Trinity Pippin (charm), Chelsea Buns and England standing.

quests.title: The Secret of Life
quests.summary: A puzzle at the pub where Crick and Watson announced the double helix.

steps.text: Ask the regular in the RAF bar about the ceiling.

quests.reward: Double Helix Pin (charm), Chelsea Buns and England standing.

quests.title: Hereward's Last Stand
quests.summary: The last English rebel against the Conqueror may still be out in the fen.

steps.text: Ask the verger in Ely Cathedral how the Isle fell.
Beat the Norman knight on the Aldreth causeway.
Face Hereward by the beacon on the camp island.

quests.reward: A chance to catch Hereward, Smoked Fen Eels and England standing.

quests.title: On the Ball, City
quests.summary: Learn why Norwich City are the Canaries, and join the Chorus.

steps.text: Ask the curator at Strangers' Hall about the canaries.
Win the Chorus Leader's blessing on the market.
Sing the song for the Kit Man at Carrow Road.

quests.reward: Canary Scarf (charm), Norfolk Dumplings and England standing.
